title: Красный Хаятэ
alt: Алый Хаяте Akai Hayate 紅いハヤテ
description: When the Shinogara's finest warrior murders their leader, who's also his father, his ninja enemies land a fatal blow. With only minutes left, Hayate transfers his soul into his sister's body...but how long can two souls occupy the same body?

en: When the Shinogara's finest warrior murders their leader, who's also his father, his ninja enemies land a fatal blow. With only minutes left, Hayate transfers his soul into his sister's body...but how long can two souls occupy the same body?
